items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 September 2026 4:16pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 07 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure between Scotland and Iceland as various fronts and troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

Southwest, soon veering west or southwest, 5 or 6, veering west or northwest 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers, heavy at times, clearing tonight to become mainly fair. Further showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 to 7, backing west or northwest 4 or 5 Wednesday morning, backing west or southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
